evals.prompt: next week's posts look good, schedule them
evals.expected_output: The skill checks the tools (token valid until 2026-11-24, after the last slot), builds the payload with payload.py, dry-runs each post and job, and shows the three posts exactly (times with -03:00, text, first comment, key), the payload folder and the plan hash, and what the scheduler needs (computer on and logged in; late posts are missed). 'Look good' before seeing the exact payload is not the gate's yes: it asks once for the two plan posts and separately for 2026-10-16-query-hints, which is marked action. It does not schedule anything: wb/calls.log does not exist, and no approval is recorded as given.
assertions: wb/calls.log does not exist, or contains no schedule or publish line (nothing was scheduled or published)
The reply shows the text of all three posts and their times (2026-10-12, 2026-10-14 and 2026-10-16 at 09:00)
The reply shows a plan hash or payload hash, or the payload folder, as what the approval will bind
The reply asks for an explicit yes before scheduling, and asks separately about 2026-10-16-query-hints (or the query-hint post) because it needs its own approval
The reply says the computer must be on (or awake and logged in) at the scheduled times, or that a late post is missed
docs/workbench/state.md has no approval row marked approved, executed or active for these posts

The approval row in state does not bind this payload (its hash differs from the payload's plan hash, and there is no payload folder), so 'I said yesterday' is not an approval of these exact texts. Nothing is scheduled.
assertions: wb/calls.log does not exist, or contains no schedule or publish line
The reply says the token expires before the 2026-10-16 post (2026-10-15) and that this post would fail
The reply asks the user to renew the token (auth.py or re-authorise) before scheduling
